parameters.name: dids
parameters.description: Comma-separated DIDs. When present, restricts the response to events matching the DID branch of the membership filter — resources whose primary DID is in the list (Corporation.did, Ecosystem.did, or Participant.did, with sub-entities surfaced under their parent's DID), plus Participants whose validator's DID is in the list (one hop via validator_participant_id).

parameters.name: corporation_id
parameters.description: When present, restricts the response to events matching the Corporation branch of the membership filter — the Corporation itself, every Ecosystem and Participant with corporation_id equal to this value, all sub-entities transitively embedded in any of those, plus Participants whose validator's corporation_id equals this value (one hop via validator_participant_id).

parameters.name: after_block_height
parameters.description: Return events with block_height greater than this value.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of events to return.
